description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. `GovPool.execute(proposalId)`; scope:'internal' + govValidators builds `GovValidators.executeInternalProposal(proposalId)` (anyone may send once Succeeded). When an action calls GovSettings.addSettings the response carries an advisory naming the chains where the proposal passes the vote and then reverts here — read it before signing.

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

scope.description: 'external' executes on GovPool; 'internal' on GovValidators (needs govValidators).

voter.description: Your address. When set, the deposit-lock warning is checked against your live power and shown only if your tokens really are locked.

name: dexe_vote_build_execute
title: Execute a passed proposal
